sampling_unit: Crossed seed+base bootstrap; K uses the same sampled seeds and an independent natural-episode resample. Draws paired across all three checkpoints.
strata: Primary: 8 fixed strata (coordinate 0..3 x sign -1/+1), 1024 bases per stratum; natural: 8192 episodes without stratification; 12 seeds.
pairing: same sampled seed vector and the same eight primary-base resamples for every checkpoint, every sampled seed and both estimands; preserve both endpoints and all five rho conditions; recompute equal-stratum mean then equal-sampled-seed mean
summary_convention: Differences and ratios of cohort means, not averages of seed ratios.
limitations: Cached seed-statistic reconstruction and saved-replicate percentile reconstruction only. No raw per-base recomputation or recreation of resampling indices; no forward evaluation or training. These descriptive intervals do not replace original Phase 1 97.5% confirmatory intervals.
